```python
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def get_data_from_url(url):
    response = requests.get(url)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
    table = soup.find('table')  # Assuming the data is in a table
    rows = table.find_all('tr')
    headers = [header.text.strip() for header in rows[0].find_all('th')]
    data = []
    for row in rows[1:]:
        cols = row.find_all('td')
        cols = [col.text.strip() for col in cols]
        data.append(cols)
    df = pd.DataFrame(data, columns=headers)
    return df

def fetch_crypto_data():
    urls = [
        "https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/top_gainers_overview",
        "https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/bitcoin/historical-data/",
        "https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbestechcouncil/2021/08/17/the-evolving-regulatory-framework-for-cryptocurrency/"
    ]
    dfs = []
    for url in urls:
        dfs.append(get_data_from_url(url))
    return dfs

def analyze_and_visualize(df1, df2, df3):
    combined_df = pd.concat([df1, df2, df3], axis=1)
    combined_df.dropna(inplace=True)  # Remove rows with missing values
    combined_df.to_csv('crypto_data.csv', index=False)

    # Visualization
    combined_df['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(combined_df['Date'])
    combined_df.set_index('Date', inplace=True)

    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
    combined_df[['Market Capitalization', 'Adoption Rate', 'Regulatory Measures']].plot()
    plt.title('Cryptocurrency Trends Over the Past Five Years')
    plt.xlabel('Year')
    plt.ylabel('Value')
    plt.legend(title='Metrics')
    plt.show()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    dfs = fetch_crypto_data()
    analyze_and_visualize(dfs[0], dfs[1], dfs[2])
``
